visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dark studio setting with a single brownish-grey, translucent smoky quartz crystal pillar mounted on a white plastic base. The lighting is warm and comes from the side, casting soft shadows on the glass table. (2) The lighting switches to ultraviolet (UV), causing the entire crystal to luminesce in a vivid, high-saturation neon green color against the pitch-black background. (3) The camera provides a extreme close-up under normal bright lighting, revealing clear, grape-like clusters of hyalite opal (玉滴石) that have formed along the edges and top of the smoky quartz pillar. (4) The scene alternates back to UV lighting, showing the specific green glow emanating only from the hyalite clusters while the main quartz body remains dark and inert. (5) A final sequence shows a rotating view of the specimen on a motorized stand, transitioning between normal lighting and UV lighting to contrast the physical form and the fluorescent property. (6) Text overlays remain consistent at the top and bottom of the frame throughout the transitions.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 你有所不知的 茶水晶共生玉滴石. [Logo]: 星期天的螢光礦物圖鑑. [Subtitle]: 你現在看到的. [Variety]: 茶水晶柱二次共生玉滴石（產地：納米比亞）. [Logo]: 星期天配音是對的. (2) [Subtitle]: 是一支不太尋常的茶水晶柱. (3) [Subtitle]: 茶水晶本身是沒有螢光反應的. (4) [Subtitle]: 但是這支水晶用紫外線一照. (5) [Subtitle]: 居然會釋放強烈的綠色螢光. (6) [Subtitle]: 仔細近看. (7) [Subtitle]: 原來是有玉滴石. (8) [Subtitle]: 沿著水晶柱邊緣二次共生. (9) [Subtitle]: 甚至在晶柱的頂端. (10) [Subtitle]: 堆出了水珠形狀. (11) [Subtitle]: 這些發出綠色螢光的部分. (12) [Subtitle]: 就是玉滴石. (13) [Subtitle]: 這還真是不可思議. (14) [Subtitle]: 由於是發出綠色螢光的茶晶表面. (15) [Subtitle]: 這種容易讓人誤會的情況. (16) [Subtitle]: 學者稱為. (17) [Subtitle]: 綠茶表. (18) [Subtitle]: 我們下回見.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A dark, controlled studio environment with a glass or polished surface where the mineral specimen is placed. The background is mostly black to emphasize the luminescence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a clear, enunciated male voice performing a professional narration. He speaks at a moderate, conversational pace. A gentle, mid-tempo ambient synthesizer track plays in the background, providing a calm and curious atmosphere. (2) A very faint mechanical click is audible as the speaker describes the crystal's reaction to light, possibly mimicking a switch. The vocal quality is smooth with consistent volume and no signs of strain. (3) As the technical description of the mineral clusters begins, the music remains constant, serving as a steady tonal foundation. There are no sudden bursts of noise or distracting SFX. (4) The speaker uses a slightly humorous inflection when using the pun 'Green Tea Surface', though the overall tone remains educational. (5) The narration concludes with a polite sign-off while the ambient music swells briefly before fading into complete silence along with the master track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Demonstration of Property -> Detailed Inspection -> Scientific Classification -> Summary Puns.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about a rare mineral combination—smoky quartz with hyalite opal—specifically focusing on its intense green fluorescence under UV light. It uses clear visual evidence and a technical but accessible commentary to engage mineral enthusiasts, ending with a pun to increase social media relatability.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features a play on words (pun) at the end, calling the mineral 'Green Tea Surface' (綠茶表), which is a homophone for a popular Chinese slang term, likely intended to increase viewer engagement through humor.
